basic_info.description: Established in 1906, Jordan Park is one of the eight residence parks in San Francisco, characterized by large homes set on spacious lots with lawns and lush gardens. Distinctly detached, 19 Jordan Avenue is a shingle-style home with a single gable that offers an abundance of natural light, enhancing its already bright and airy ambiance. The architectural character is rooted in the Arts and Crafts movement, an example of which is the living room fireplace with its elaborate flora pattern. In the past year, the home was renovated while retaining its original features. The property received a brand-new electrical system, roof, a stylish outdoor deck and garden, updated chef's kitchen, and modern bathrooms with soaking tubs. The formal living room is large and light-filled, and flows into the formal dining room for ideal entertaining. An excellent floor plan offers three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a family room on the upper level. The serene and bright office is on the main level. A hallmark of 19 Jordan Avenue is undoubtedly the beauty of its rooms; each space feels inviting. Here at last is the opportunity to make 19 Jordan Avenue yours.
